increment: Main-order percentage input, directional review, frozen submission and recovery-aware wallet-return guard
implemented: Initial zero-percent slider with blank input, disabled until an explicit validated capacity read. Exact 0–100 integer percentages floor each side independently to the exchange quantity lattice; no minimum uplift.

Separate buy/sell quantities and base/quote display; selected-side input preserves exact base quantity when switching units. User editing leaves percentage mode and retains separate raw manual inputs. Editing never triggers private reads.

Maxima follow the selected base/quote unit; directional buttons retain disabled placeholders and show their own estimated base quantity or quote amount. Known zero capacity remains distinct from missing data.

Click captures direction, order type, exact quantity and form terms before at most five fresh signed capacity reads. Reduced capacity rejects the captured size; increased capacity never enlarges it. Standard mode-specific confirmation preferences still apply.

Confirmation and the actual signed repository POST guard recheck identity, selected symbol, form revision, account context, capacity snapshot, expiry, settings and recovery state. Expected wallet switching retains the original 30-second deadline.

Current order persistence is exempt only for the active order lease and its own client ID. All storage readiness/failures and other pending order, margin, rebalance and internal-transfer records still block sending.

Accepted original-ID query resets percentage to zero and blanks its display. Rejected signatures retain intent. Unknown results retain inputs and block another placement; only the original client ID is queried, never resent.
Slider has an independent accessible subtree during dialog/form transitions. EN/ZH widget tests exercise narrow portrait, landscape, tablet and enlarged text without disabling semantics.
remaining_required_work: Live public-price and account-event recomputation: current previews use a bounded signed/preflight price snapshot, not a continuous market feed. Account/settings/expiry changes invalidate rather than silently using stale facts.
Post-trade independent liquidation estimates across applicable account, margin and position modes; no use of pre-order liquidationPrice as a post-trade value.
Fresh directional-capacity guards and usable dual action buttons for manual sizing; manual submit retains its existing preflight/confirmation checks and does not use the new percentage guard.
Verified reserved-notional and moving-price assumptions for conditional, pending-market and BBO orders; unsupported capacity remains unknown.
Latest directional maximum in a dedicated over-capacity error; current safe error preserves input and panel exposes the latest available maximum.
Full strategy list/edit/cancel, Chase recovery, full cross-product Portfolio and Swap remain unfinished; only historical statistics/Summary/TWAP are user-deferred.
boundaries: Available budget, prices, leverage and filters remain references and do not guarantee exchange acceptance, a fill price, spending cap or execution. Fees and future margin release are not credited by this opening-cost kernel.
Account and orders are separate signed responses, not an atomic exchange snapshot. Post-wallet guard rejects observed changes/expiry; it is not a new complete account read after each signature.
Reference snapshot tests and MockClient requests prove client behavior, not actual EOA/API signer authorization, balances, fills, on-chain execution or real native behavior.
No real wallet prompt, private/funding/chat request, address-bearing RPC, device tools, APK install or external publication in this increment. iOS unavailable on Linux.
